verdict.rationale: ELSTER is a government tax-filing service, so publishing bulk public-data extracts is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence shows it publishes datasets, registry extracts or statistics for bulk download. The only related item is a probe noting that ERiC taxonomy and download bundles were once fetched keylessly from a developer-artifact host. Those are software and developer artifacts, not public-data extracts, and the host now times out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
